# Feature selection methods for scRNA-seq integration and querying

## Takeaway

Feature-selection choices interact with the integration method and the query task. The useful result is a benchmark-aware choice of HVG, batch-aware HVG or lineage-specific markers, rather than a universal gene count.

## Input and output

- Input: raw counts, batch labels and, when relevant, lineage or reference labels.
- Output: selected feature lists plus integration/query evaluation metrics.
- Record: number of features, detection threshold, batch rule and downstream metric.

## Official material

- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02624-3
- Reproducibility repository: https://github.com/truong128/atlas-feature-selection-benchmark_single_cell_RNA-seq
- Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.13995812
- Turnkey entry: R/02_feature_selection_benchmark.R.

## Limitation

The benchmark does not remove the need to match the feature strategy to tissue, sample size, integration method and query goal.
